25-0482.description: Commissioner Ivory's resolution, co-sponsored by Commissioners Thorne and Ellis, lists in writing the County fringe benefits offered to Superior Court Judges of the Atlanta Judicial Circuit as of June 30, 2025. A new state law, House Bill 85, creates locality pay for these judges but lets counties keep providing benefits as they were on that date. The benefits include health, life, dental and vision insurance, 401(a) and 457(b) plans, disability insurance and retiree health coverage. They would continue for current judges, and could be offered to new judges, if funded each year.

25-0723.description: Chairman Pitts's resolution would make Friday, December 26, 2025, and Friday, January 2, 2026, Administrative Holidays for Fulton County government. Because the December 24-25 and December 31-January 1 holidays both fall on Wednesday and Thursday, this would spare most employees from returning to work for just one day before the weekend. County offices, including the government centers and courthouse, would close on those Fridays, and essential employees who must work would earn holiday leave for each hour worked.
